title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
**Role Overview:**

Lead embedded firmware development, hardware integration, system optimization, and product engineering across a portfolio of medical devices, including neurological devices, ECG systems, and other emerging medical technologies. The role focuses on developing reliable, high-performance embedded systems from prototyping through verification and production.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Embedded Firmware Development**

* Design, develop, implement, debug, and maintain firmware for RTOS-based and event driven medical devices.
* Develop device-control logic, sensor interfaces, data acquisition, signal processing, and communication modules.

**2. Hardware Integration & System Development**

* Integrate optical sensors, physiological signal acquisition circuits, analog front ends, displays, batteries, and communication modules.
* Develop and debug interfaces such as UART, SPI, I²C, BLE, and Wi-Fi.
* Troubleshoot hardware–firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debugging tools.

**3. System Performance & Reliability**

* Diagnose and resolve firmware latency, startup delays, interface freezes, data acquisition errors, and connectivity issues.
* Optimise processing speed, memory usage, power consumption, and system responsiveness.
* Conduct debugging, regression testing, and reliability verification.

**4. New Product Development**

* Support the development of new medical device platforms.
* Adapt firmware and embedded architectures for new sensors, hardware configurations, and functional requirements.
* Contribute to prototyping, feasibility studies, design improvements, and technology integration.

**5. Connectivity & Embedded Security**

* Develop device communication protocols, bootloaders, and firmware update mechanisms.
* Implement robust update, recovery, error-handling, and data-protection processes.
* Support embedded cybersecurity and secure device communication.

**6. Verification & Regulatory Documentation**

* Prepare firmware requirements, design documentation, test protocols, traceability records, and release documentation.
* Support software verification, risk management, design validation, and change control in accordance with applicable standards, including IEC 62304 and ISO 14971.
* Collaborate with quality and regulatory teams to maintain design and development records.

**7. Production & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Support prototype testing, design verification, manufacturing transfer, and production troubleshooting.
* Work with electronics, mechanical, optics, software, clinical, and quality teams.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical reviews and engineering best practices.

**Educational Qualifications**

B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

**Required Skills**

* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++.
* Hands-on experience with ARM-based microcontrollers and microprocessors.
* Knowledge of RTOS, interrupts, timers, DMA, peripheral drivers, and hardware debugging.
* Experience with sensor integration, data acquisition, and communication interfaces.
* Familiarity with Git, systematic testing, and firmware debugging tools.

**Preferred Experience**

* Medical devices, physiological signal acquisition, optical sensing, or diagnostic instruments.
* BLE/Wi-Fi connectivity, FOTA, bootloader development, and embedded cybersecurity.
* Battery-powered systems.
* Medical-device software lifecycle processes and regulated product development.

title: Senior Systems Engineer for Lunar Surface Systems
description:
**About Us**
At CosmoChute, we are building modular, reusable lunar robotics infrastructure for long-duration planetary operations. Our systems combine mobility, modular payload deployment, survivability through lunar nights, and repair ability to make sustained presence on the Moon economically viable. We’re a deeply technical, fast-moving team that believes in real ownership, real trust and in creating an environment where your best work matters.
  
  
If you want to work on hardware that will one day operate on the moon, this is the role.
  
  
**Your Role**
We're looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to own the technical coherence of our lunar surface systems. You'll sit at the intersection of every engineering discipline on the team, responsible for making sure the system works as a whole. The responsibilities include definitions and management of the requirements, managing interfaces, driving trade studies, and being the person who catches the problems that fall between subsystem boundaries before they become mission risks.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Own the system-level requirements architecture for the LEAP platform
* Work directly with the CTO on mission-level technical decisions
* Define and manage interface control documents (ICDs) across mechanical, electrical, software, and operational interfaces
* Maintain Technical Budgets across domains
* Lead system-level trade studies and support key design decisions with rigorous analysis
* Maintain the ConOps and mission analysis iterations and documentation through the design lifecycle
* Develop and own the system verification and validation plan, and coordinate V&V activities across the team
* Identify and manage system-level risks
* Support FMECA and fault tree analysis across subsystems
* Act as the integrating voice in design reviews, keeping subsystem decisions anchored to mission and system-level requirements

Requirements
  
  
**Must have**

* Experience of 5+ years in the same or similar domain.
* Experience leading or contributing to all the phases of the systems engineering lifecycle
* Experience in Requirements Engineering, Configuration Management, Architecture Trade Studies, Interface Management and V&V Campaigns
* Comfortable working across discipline boundaries
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, STK AGI, GMAT or similar Mission Analysis and Mission Design platforms
* Rigorous systems thinker who can prioritize mission reliability and also move fast when the situation demands it.
* Good to have
* Experience with model-based or document-based SE tools (DOORS, Cameo, or equivalent)
* Experience on planetary, lunar, or deep space missions
* Familiarity with ECSS, NASA systems engineering standards, or equivalent
* Exposure to robotic or autonomous surface systems

**What we deeply value**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering,, or related engineering field
* Curiosity, initiative, and ownership
* Ability to objectively weigh design decisions and maintain inter-domain cooperation
* Practical engineering judgment and first principles thinking
* Profound mutual respect among co-workers
* Willingness to iterate rapidly
* Passion for robotics, space systems, and exploration technologies

Benefits
  
  

* Competitive compensation
* Equity participation
* Meaningful long-term growth potential
* Complete honesty with only legally required abstractions
